geojson_contract.coordinates: WGS 84 EPSG:4326 longitude, latitude decimal degrees; all LineString; exact M6 geometry preserved
geojson_contract.bbox: [minimum longitude, minimum latitude, maximum longitude, maximum latitude]

temporal_boundary_convention.endpoints: Inclusive at annual granularity; start and end both display, including a same-year pair
temporal_boundary_convention.meaning: Within proposed earliest/latest passenger-use outer envelope, not proven active service in that year
temporal_boundary_convention.null_policy: No missing years in this delivery. A consumer must explicitly handle any future missing/invalid year; do not coerce null to zero or infinity.
temporal_boundary_convention.exclusions: Do not silently subtract prose interruptions, infer full-year continuity, or substitute uncertainty-expanded bounds. Do not interpret years as construction or track removal.
temporal_boundary_convention.uncertainty_ranges: Inclusive editorial plausible bounds around each endpoint, not a statistical confidence interval; zero-width does not mean verified
temporal_boundary_convention.persistent_caveat: Proposed outer-year envelope; does not establish uninterrupted service.

segment_id.definition: Stable PhysicalSegment.id from M6; authoritative join key to evidence and identity manifest.

fid.definition: Current M6 PhysicalSegment fid, retained for human reference. Never use as the durable join key.

name.definition: Exact current M6 PhysicalSegment.label. Preferred display name; not rewritten or inferred.

estimate_label.definition: Historical source-ledger segment_label, retained for provenance only. Not the current M6 name.

atlas_area_id.definition: Current M6 atlas area identifier, copied without reinterpretation. Values include DC, ALX, ARL, FFX, MONT and PG.

geometry_hash.definition: SHA-256 matching ResearchGeometry.working_geometry_hash and recovered estimate.geometry_hash. Recomputed from geometry JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False.

estimate_id.definition: Recovered provisional estimate identifier; separate from the physical-segment stable ID.

start_year.definition: Alias of recovered opening_best_year: proposed earliest passenger-use year for one or more identified portions of this generalized segment. Not a track installation date.

end_year.definition: Alias of recovered closing_best_year: proposed latest passenger-use year for one or more identified portions of this generalized segment. Not a track removal date.

start_earliest_year.definition: Alias of opening_earliest_year: earliest inclusive editorial plausible value of the opening endpoint, not an independently established operating date.

start_latest_year.definition: Alias of opening_latest_year: latest inclusive editorial plausible value of the opening endpoint, not proof of service from this year.

end_earliest_year.definition: Alias of closing_earliest_year: earliest inclusive editorial plausible value of the closing endpoint, not proof of service through this year.

end_latest_year.definition: Alias of closing_latest_year: latest inclusive editorial plausible value of the closing endpoint, not an independently established operating date.

start_confidence.type: string enum: high, medium, low, very_low
start_confidence.definition: Recovered opening_confidence, unchanged. Qualitative editorial assessment, not a probability and not verification.

end_confidence.type: string enum: high, medium, low, very_low
end_confidence.definition: Recovered closing_confidence, unchanged. Qualitative editorial assessment, not a probability and not verification.

confidence_group.definition: Derived from the lower-rated endpoint in order very_low < low < medium < high. very_low = either endpoint very_low; low = either low and neither very_low; medium_high = both medium/high.

estimate_status.definition: Recovered status: provisional_not_verified_not_admitted. No promotion into canonical OperatingPeriods or verified dates.

mixed_subextent.definition: True when recovery audit found explicit subextent records/differing scoped histories. Fourteen true values. False does not establish uniformity; additional prose may contain mixed history.

has_known_periods.definition: True when the recovered known_periods array is nonempty. These records are heterogeneous evidence, not a normalized service timeline.

citation_review_warning.definition: Recovery-audit citation-scope caution. Five populated warnings: fids 1,2,3,6,112. Does not itself establish that a proposed endpoint year is incorrect.

continuous_operation_asserted.definition: Always false. This package never asserts uninterrupted operation between proposed endpoints.

whole_segment_uniform_lifespan_asserted.definition: Always false. Endpoint estimates may describe different portions of the same generalized carrier.

source_ids.definition: Recovered direct/source association IDs resolving to source_registry.json. A listed source may support a scoped event/corridor, not exact authored vertices or the entire envelope.

context_source_ids.definition: Recovered contextual source IDs resolving to source_registry.json; do not treat automatically as direct endpoint proof.

basis_claim_ids.definition: Historical claim identifiers retained for provenance. Embedded original claim/source payloads are not included in this public projection; consult the separately supplied recovery data for those records.

evidence_id.definition: Equals segment_id. Lookup key in evidence.json.segments and recovered_ledger_sanitized.json.

start_estimated_date.definition: Alias of opening_best_date. Only fids 237/238 have 1923-12-02. Day-precision estimate, not a verified date. Not used by annual filtering.

end_estimated_date.definition: Alias of closing_best_date. All values null in this delivery; no day-precision closing estimate is supplied.

start_precision.definition: Recovered opening_precision. year for 267 segments and day for two; precision does not establish verification.

end_precision.definition: Recovered closing_precision. Year precision for all 269.

verified_start_date.definition: Alias of verified_opening_date. All null. Do not fill from start_year or start_estimated_date.

verified_end_date.definition: Alias of verified_closing_date. All null. Do not fill from end_year or end_estimated_date.

passenger_use_existence.definition: Recovered passenger-use qualification, unchanged. Read together with geometry_correspondence, operational_role_uncertainty and evidence; not a broad passenger/nonpassenger boolean.

geometry_correspondence.definition: Recovered qualification of historical evidence’s correspondence to this exact geometry, unchanged. Matching source and M6 geometry hashes does not resolve historical spatial uncertainty.

uncertainty_reason_group.definition: Recovered qualitative uncertainty category, unchanged. Identifies date/course, specific geometry, operating-use, apparatus or mode-scope concerns; not an exclusion rule.

evidence_schema.segments[segment_id].recovered_ledger: Curated factual/editorial fields only: endpoint rationale, scope/uncertainty descriptions, known_periods, subextent_estimates, alternative_scenarios, and basis_evidence claim IDs. Full original source payloads omitted.
evidence_schema.segments[segment_id].audit.recommended_n: Recovery-audit recommended research, not a newly executed or verified result

source_registry_schema.title: Recovered bibliographic title; some explicitly lack a supplied title
source_registry_schema.creator: Recovered creator or null
source_registry_schema.publication_date_text: Recovered publication-date text or null; not necessarily event date
source_registry_schema.source_uri: Retained HTTP(S) URL, or null when missing/incomplete/token-bearing; not live checked

nested_evidence_semantics: Known periods, subextent estimates and alternative scenarios are retained short factual/editorial summaries. They are not normalized operating intervals. basis_evidence contains only claim IDs; scope_evidence is empty in the public projection.
provenance_reference: metadata.json records binding, original data hashes and the public evidence projection. Full local recovery evidence and its validation are supplied separately.
